LanguageData.VBE_GeneModdedBeauty.title: Old-world beauty
LanguageData.VBE_GeneModdedBeauty.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the product of one of the old world's most lavish cosmetic clinics. During [PAWN_possessive] life, [PAWN_pronoun] spent an untold fortune on [PAWN_possessive] looks and had little time to practice anything more practical.
LanguageData.VBE_HumanFarm.title: Organ-farm escapee
LanguageData.VBE_HumanFarm.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised inside an illegal organ farm, kept alive only as a source of replacement tissue for wealthy clients. Watching surgeons work through the glass taught [PAWN_objective] more anatomy than any child should know. When a raider attack shattered the facility, [PAWN_pronoun] escaped into the wastes.
LanguageData.VBE_CaveinSurvivor.title: Forced-mine survivor
LanguageData.VBE_CaveinSurvivor.baseDesc: Raiders destroyed [PAWN_nameDef]'s home and sold [PAWN_objective] to an unsafe scrap mine. A tunnel collapse killed the guards and every other laborer in [PAWN_possessive] shift. After digging [PAWN_objective]self free, [PAWN_pronoun] learned every trade that might keep [PAWN_objective] from ever entering a mine again.
LanguageData.VBE_ModelCitizen.title: Vault-conditioned citizen
LanguageData.VBE_ModelCitizen.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a violent troublemaker until [PAWN_possessive] vault overseer enrolled [PAWN_objective] in an experimental behavioral program. Drugs, repetition and cheerful civic slogans produced a courteous model resident. Whether that change was rehabilitation or erasure remains unclear.
LanguageData.VBE_DogWalker.title: Kennel handler
LanguageData.VBE_DogWalker.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] volunteered at a settlement kennel, exercising guard dogs and calming animals rescued from the wastes. What began as charity became a livelihood as caravan masters paid for reliable, well-trained hounds. Few people understand pack behavior as naturally as [PAWN_pronoun] does.
LanguageData.VBE_FashionDesigner.title: Pre-War fashion designer
LanguageData.VBE_FashionDesigner.baseDesc: Before the Great War, [PAWN_nameDef] designed daring clothes for runways, casinos and advertising campaigns. Critics called [PAWN_possessive] work impractical; [PAWN_pronoun] called it fabulous. Years behind a sewing machine left [PAWN_objective] with a practiced hand for textiles and presentation.
LanguageData.VBE_CannibalisticSurgeon.title: White Glove surgeon
LanguageData.VBE_CannibalisticSurgeon.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] practiced surgery for an exclusive Strip society whose banquets were spoken of only in whispers. When [PAWN_possessive] private appetites threatened the society's reputation, its leaders arranged a quiet exile. [PAWN_pronoun] left with excellent medical training and some deeply unsettling culinary opinions.
LanguageData.VBE_LivingCure.title: West-Tek serum donor
LanguageData.VBE_LivingCure.baseDesc: Tests revealed that [PAWN_nameDef]'s blood resisted several engineered diseases. West-Tek confined [PAWN_objective] in a laboratory and harvested samples for experimental serums, never intending to release such valuable property. [PAWN_pronoun] eventually escaped with a working knowledge of medicine and a lasting fear of locked clinics.
LanguageData.VBE_GeneticReincarnation.title: Continuity clone
LanguageData.VBE_GeneticReincarnation.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was grown from preserved tissue as part of a pre-War continuity project. From infancy, caretakers insisted that [PAWN_pronoun] was the return of a celebrated industrialist and demanded the same tastes, mannerisms and ambitions. Their expectations educated [PAWN_objective] well while leaving little room for a life of [PAWN_possessive] own.
LanguageData.VBE_DrillOperator.title: Pre-War drill operator
LanguageData.VBE_DrillOperator.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] operated industrial boring equipment for a pre-War mining concern. After a preventable gas-pocket collapse, the company falsified its safety reports and began silencing surviving witnesses. [PAWN_pronoun] disappeared before the lawyers could find [PAWN_objective], taking hard-earned drilling and repair skills underground.
LanguageData.VBE_Freak.title: Sideshow escapee
LanguageData.VBE_Freak.baseDesc: Visible mutations made [PAWN_nameDef] a profitable attraction for a traveling wasteland sideshow. Crowds paid to stare while the troupe forced [PAWN_objective] through elaborate performances. One night [PAWN_pronoun] slipped the cage, carrying away a performer's eye for spectacle and a deep suspicion of flattering strangers.
LanguageData.VBE_LighthouseKeeper.title: Signal-tower keeper
LanguageData.VBE_LighthouseKeeper.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] tended an isolated pre-War signal tower whose beacon guided caravans through dust storms and radioactive badlands. The machinery mostly ran itself, leaving long quiet hours for repairs and art. Others regarded the posting as punishment; [PAWN_pronoun] treasured the solitude.
LanguageData.VBE_BureaucraticProgrammer.title: Vault-Tec records programmer
LanguageData.VBE_BureaucraticProgrammer.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] wrote terminal programs that transferred data between Vault-Tec forms, compliance reports and still more forms. Every result still required an authorized clerk's approval, so little labor was actually saved. Decades at a desk sharpened [PAWN_possessive] mind but left [PAWN_objective] unprepared for physical work.
LanguageData.VBE_Barber.title: Wasteland barber-surgeon
LanguageData.VBE_Barber.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] cut hair, trimmed beards and treated small wounds from the same battered chair. A steady hand with scissors or sutures kept the caps coming, while listening to customers taught [PAWN_objective] more settlement gossip than any radio broadcast.
LanguageData.VBE_VatgrownColonist.title: West-Tek vatborn
LanguageData.VBE_VatgrownColonist.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was grown in a West-Tek development vat as a disposable test subject. [PAWN_pronoun] and the other template children knew only white coats, observation windows and numbered lessons. The fall of the facility finally opened the doors, but freedom offered no instructions.
LanguageData.VBE_ForcedPrimitivist.title: Exiled settler
LanguageData.VBE_ForcedPrimitivist.baseDesc: After a ruined harvest, [PAWN_nameDef]'s settlement blamed [PAWN_objective] and drove [PAWN_objective] beyond its walls. Years alone with crude tools forced [PAWN_objective] to learn farming, building and repairs without specialists or spare parts. Survival made [PAWN_objective] capable, but betrayal made trust difficult.
LanguageData.VBE_GiftedBurnout.title: Vault gifted burnout
LanguageData.VBE_GiftedBurnout.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s vault identified [PAWN_objective] as gifted at an early age. Constant aptitude tests, accelerated classes and impossible expectations turned praise into pressure, then pressure into collapse. [PAWN_pronoun] retains an exceptional education, although using it can reopen old wounds.
LanguageData.VBE_Demoscener.title: Terminal demoscener
LanguageData.VBE_Demoscener.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] became fascinated with antique terminals whose crude hardware blurred the line between programming and repair. [PAWN_pronoun] joined a small scene that squeezed music, animation and impossible colors from salvaged machines. Making art under severe technical limits trained both patience and ingenuity.
LanguageData.VBE_InformationSponge.title: Ruin autodidact
LanguageData.VBE_InformationSponge.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned from anything the ruins surrendered: manuals, holotapes, machines, tracks and bones. As [PAWN_possessive] knowledge deepened, conversation with less obsessive neighbors became harder. [PAWN_pronoun] eventually preferred solitary fieldwork to explaining one more obscure discovery.
LanguageData.VBE_ReincarnatedSoul.title: Old-soul child
LanguageData.VBE_ReincarnatedSoul.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] insists that [PAWN_pronoun] remembers serving a faith that vanished before the Great War. Adults dismissed the stories until [PAWN_pronoun] demonstrated recipes and handicrafts nobody had taught [PAWN_objective]. Whether memory, instinct or coincidence, [PAWN_possessive] practiced hands seem far older than [PAWN_pronoun] is.
LanguageData.VBE_LightingAssistant.title: Hubris Studios electrician
LanguageData.VBE_LightingAssistant.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] wired lamps, control boards and dangerous effects on Hubris Studios productions. Stars took the credit while [PAWN_pronoun] worked unseen behind the scenery. Endless improvisation with temperamental equipment gave [PAWN_objective] a practical education in electronics and fabrication.
LanguageData.VBE_SiloManager.title: Poseidon depot manager
LanguageData.VBE_SiloManager.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] managed a vast Poseidon Energy storage depot where underpaid crews moved fuel and materials beneath towering tanks. Terminals, manifests and production quotas filled [PAWN_possessive] days; physical labor did not. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how supplies disappear on paper long before they vanish from a shelf.
LanguageData.VBE_Pushover.title: Exploited scholarship child
LanguageData.VBE_Pushover.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] earned a settlement scholarship and immediately became the child everyone pressured into doing their lessons. Long nights completing other people's work produced excellent marks and a broad education. The bullying also left [PAWN_objective] withdrawn, resentful and painfully unsure around others.
LanguageData.VBE_AnomalousCreatureResearcher.title: Dunwich field researcher
LanguageData.VBE_AnomalousCreatureResearcher.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] catalogued mutated wildlife and stranger finds for a secretive Dunwich expedition. Management called every disappearance an accident and every impossible specimen a geological curiosity. After one containment failure too many, [PAWN_pronoun] abandoned the project with extensive notes and recurring nightmares.
LanguageData.VBE_ShipSalvager.title: Airship wreck salvager
LanguageData.VBE_ShipSalvager.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living dismantling crashed vertibirds, ruined airships and anything else too large to drag home intact. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to identify valuable machinery quickly and cut it loose before fuel, unstable ammunition or rival scavengers ended the job.
LanguageData.VBE_CivilRightsActivist.title: Pre-War civil-rights organizer
LanguageData.VBE_CivilRightsActivist.baseDesc: Before the Great War, [PAWN_nameDef] organized demonstrations against discrimination, political repression and corporate abuse. [PAWN_pronoun] designed posters, negotiated with officials and kept frightened crowds speaking with one voice. Government files described [PAWN_objective] as a dangerous agitator.
LanguageData.VBE_UrbworldRioter.title: Food-riot veteran
LanguageData.VBE_UrbworldRioter.baseDesc: When ration protests met batons and bullets, [PAWN_nameDef] fought back in the streets. Outmatched by armored security, [PAWN_pronoun] fashioned weapons, protection and medical supplies from whatever the crowd could seize. Hunger taught [PAWN_objective] that peaceful words only work when someone listens.
LanguageData.VBE_HumanSupremacist.title: Human-purity agitator
LanguageData.VBE_HumanSupremacist.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] built a following by blaming mutants, ghouls and laboratory-made humans for society's collapse. [PAWN_possessive] claims were prejudiced, but rehearsed with enough confidence to sound convincing to frightened crowds. Every debate became another recruitment speech.
LanguageData.VBE_FoodCritic.title: Strip food critic
LanguageData.VBE_FoodCritic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] used a celebrated parent's name to review the Strip's restaurants, casino buffets and private supper clubs. A favorable notice could fill tables; a cutting paragraph could empty them. Chefs feared [PAWN_possessive] palate almost as much as they courted [PAWN_possessive] approval.
LanguageData.VBE_MarineworldResearcher.title: Coastal aquaculture researcher
LanguageData.VBE_MarineworldResearcher.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] studied algae, mirelurk behavior and salt-tolerant crops in hopes of feeding coastal settlements. Years among flooded laboratories made [PAWN_objective] an authority on aquatic food systems. They did little for [PAWN_possessive] social life or any skill beyond the work.
LanguageData.VBE_Informant.title: Protected informant
LanguageData.VBE_Informant.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] traded evidence against a powerful criminal outfit for a new name and a guarded journey out of town. Investigators taught [PAWN_objective] what to notice, what to remember and how to survive questioning. Protection ended at the settlement gate; the enemies did not.
LanguageData.VBE_Oracle.title: Wasteland seer
LanguageData.VBE_Oracle.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s visions, outbursts and uncanny guesses always kept others at a cautious distance. [PAWN_pronoun] would have been cast out long ago if so many warnings had not proved true. Some call it prophecy, others radiation sickness; [PAWN_nameDef] offers no explanation.
LanguageData.VBE_Translator.title: Caravan interpreter
LanguageData.VBE_Translator.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned the dialects, trade signs and tribal phrases needed to guide caravans across faction borders. Quiet weeks between journeys gave [PAWN_objective] time to read and tend a garden. Long periods without company, however, left [PAWN_objective] uneasy among strangers.
LanguageData.VBE_Maid.title: Resort housekeeper
LanguageData.VBE_Maid.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] cleaned rooms at a once-luxurious resort that survived by serving traders, gamblers and people who never gave real names. [PAWN_pronoun] learned when a stain needed soap, when it needed discretion and when a guest's belongings should not be touched at all.
LanguageData.VBE_AbandonedColonist.title: Abandoned settlement survivor
LanguageData.VBE_AbandonedColonist.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] joined an expedition to reclaim a distant settlement. When defenses failed, its leaders loaded the last vehicles with their favorites and left everyone else behind. [PAWN_nameDef] survived the ruins and swore to find the people who decided [PAWN_possessive] life was expendable.
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateSpy.title: Pre-War industrial spy
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateSpy.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] stole prototypes, personnel files and production secrets for a pre-War conglomerate. Every assignment required a new cover and a convincing smile; failed assignments required a steady gun and a quick repair to sabotaged equipment. When [PAWN_pronoun] learned too much about [PAWN_possessive] own employer, [PAWN_pronoun] became the next secret to erase.
LanguageData.VBE_Bullleaper.title: Brahmin rodeo acrobat
LanguageData.VBE_Bullleaper.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] danced between the horns and over the backs of charging brahmin for roaring fairground crowds. Success demanded agility and a precise understanding of frightened animals. Failure was common enough that [PAWN_pronoun] also learned to provide first aid between performances.
LanguageData.VBE_DroneOperator.title: RobCo security-drone operator
LanguageData.VBE_DroneOperator.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] monitored a network of RobCo security drones protecting a corporate freight depot. Most shifts meant maintenance logs and empty camera feeds; rare intrusions demanded fast judgment before an automated weapon chose its own target. The bombs fell while [PAWN_pronoun] was still at the console.
LanguageData.VBE_Standardbearer.title: Militia color-bearer
LanguageData.VBE_Standardbearer.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carried [PAWN_possessive] settlement's colors into battle, keeping scattered militia fighters oriented through dust and gunfire. [PAWN_pronoun] learned when to lead an advance, signal a retreat and plant the standard where frightened defenders could see it.
LanguageData.VBE_ArtCritic.title: Whitespring art critic
LanguageData.VBE_ArtCritic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] judged paintings, sculpture and restored antiques for Whitespring patrons who valued reputation above taste. A few polished sentences from [PAWN_objective] could make a scavenged canvas priceless or end an artist's career before dinner.
LanguageData.VBE_IndustrialWorldCounterterrorist.base: [PAWN_nameDef] served in a pre-War counterterror unit during the years of riots, sabotage and public panic. [PAWN_pronoun] learned negotiation, close combat and emergency medicine while confronting groups whose anger [PAWN_pronoun] sometimes understood. Barracks staff handled ordinary chores, leaving [PAWN_objective] poorly prepared for civilian life.
LanguageData.VBE_TaxCollector.title: Settlement tithe collector
LanguageData.VBE_TaxCollector.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] collected caps, crops and ammunition owed to a settlement council. Merchants despised [PAWN_objective], guards tolerated [PAWN_objective], and the council rewarded every full ledger. The job taught [PAWN_objective] how to value goods and recognize a lie before the counting finished.
LanguageData.VBE_ProsecutedWarVeteran.title: Convicted war veteran
LanguageData.VBE_ProsecutedWarVeteran.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fought on the losing side of a bitter regional war and became skilled in close, confused combat. When the shooting stopped, the victors tried [PAWN_objective] for acts committed under [PAWN_possessive] old command. Rank, home and reputation were taken, leaving a soldier poorly adjusted to peace.
LanguageData.VBE_PondDesigner.title: Strip water-garden designer
LanguageData.VBE_PondDesigner.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] designed extravagant pools and water gardens for Strip casinos. Keeping delicate plants alive beneath desert sun required obsessive control of every pipe, insect and handful of soil. After a client ruined one ecosystem for decoration, [PAWN_pronoun] left to build something no wealthy fool could rearrange.
LanguageData.VBE_Cryonic.title: Pre-War cryonics survivor
LanguageData.VBE_Cryonic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] entered an experimental cryonics program shortly before the Great War. Centuries later, scavengers restored power to the pod and sold its living contents to a research clinic. [PAWN_nameDef] escaped before becoming a permanent specimen, carrying fragments of pre-War knowledge and a lasting distrust of smiling doctors.
LanguageData.VBE_ChemfuelFarmer.title: Wasteland biofuel rancher
LanguageData.VBE_ChemfuelFarmer.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] saw a fortune in turning hardy crops and animal waste into lamp fuel and engine alcohol. Soon [PAWN_possessive] family was raising brahmin, the neighbors were planting feedstock, and every shed held an improvised still. One spectacular fire ended the enterprise and most local relationships.
LanguageData.VBE_TrainDriver.title: Railway engineer
LanguageData.VBE_TrainDriver.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] drove a restored locomotive along one of the few rail lines cleared after the War. Keeping it moving meant shoveling fuel, repairing ancient machinery and inspecting tunnels by hand. When raiders tore up the track, [PAWN_pronoun] saved the engine but lost the route that gave it purpose.
LanguageData.VBE_ClonedHeir.title: Continuity-program clone
LanguageData.VBE_ClonedHeir.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created by a continuity program to replace the presumed-dead heir of a wealthy pre-War family. Tutors taught [PAWN_objective] etiquette and administration, but [PAWN_pronoun] preferred violence to boardroom ritual. When the original heir emerged alive, the family discarded its imperfect replacement.
LanguageData.VBE_ImperialCircusPerformer.title: Wasteland circus performer
LanguageData.VBE_ImperialCircusPerformer.baseDesc: Across the wastes, [PAWN_nameDef] performed acrobatics, stage fights and improbable escapes beneath a patched circus tent. [PAWN_pronoun] tells endless stories about command performances for governors and casino bosses. Nobody can determine how many are true, least of all [PAWN_nameDef].
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateMascot.title: Nuka-Cola mascot
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateMascot.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] danced, waved and repeated cheerful slogans inside a suffocating Nuka-Cola mascot suit. The corporation paid almost nothing and prohibited [PAWN_objective] from breaking character in public. Years of forced enthusiasm taught performance, patience and a permanent hatred of jingles.
LanguageData.VBE_AquaponicWorker.title: Vault aquaponics worker
LanguageData.VBE_AquaponicWorker.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the fish tanks, filters and vegetable beds that kept [PAWN_possessive] vault fed. A failed pump could threaten hundreds of residents, so [PAWN_pronoun] learned to notice small changes in water and plants. Long solitary shifts left little time for conversation.
LanguageData.VBE_Foreman.title: Uranium-mine foreman
LanguageData.VBE_Foreman.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] supervised a uranium mine where damaged supports and invisible radiation could kill as surely as raiders. Unlike distant owners, [PAWN_pronoun] worked beside the crews, enforced safety rules and earned their loyalty. The company considered both the precautions and the wages excessive.
LanguageData.VBE_ChildofTheAnimaTree.title: Treefather ward
LanguageData.VBE_ChildofTheAnimaTree.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised among Treeminders beneath the branches of their Treefather. They taught [PAWN_objective] to tend living things, listen before speaking and treat strange dreams as messages carried through root and soil. Whether the connection is psychic or sacred, [PAWN_nameDef] feels it deeply.
LanguageData.VBE_AnimatronicMechanic.title: Theme-park animatronics mechanic
LanguageData.VBE_AnimatronicMechanic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] repaired singing mascots, mechanical performers and safety systems at a decaying theme park. Management demanded smiling characters no matter how often their motors burned out or their programming turned dangerous. [PAWN_pronoun] became an inventive mechanic under relentless deadlines.
LanguageData.VBE_Simraised.title: Vault simulation child
LanguageData.VBE_Simraised.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up inside a vault chamber where machines projected an idyllic neighborhood over concrete walls. Robot caretakers kept the simulation safe, orderly and entirely false. Discovering the maintenance door left [PAWN_objective] hungry for a real world [PAWN_pronoun] barely understood.
LanguageData.VBE_ForsakenPatriot.title: Disavowed black operative
LanguageData.VBE_ForsakenPatriot.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carried out deniable operations for [PAWN_possessive] government with absolute loyalty. When one mission became politically inconvenient, officials announced [PAWN_possessive] death and arranged a secret exile. [PAWN_pronoun] survived as promised, provided [PAWN_pronoun] never returned to expose the people [PAWN_pronoun] served.
LanguageData.VBE_BloodlineFounder.title: Founder's heir
LanguageData.VBE_BloodlineFounder.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] had a fiercely contested origin, with no one willing to admit [PAWN_possessive] connection to a powerful founder's bloodline. Somehow, [PAWN_pronoun] still carried the legacy of an old regime, and when those rights came to light, suddenly everyone wanted a piece of what remained.
LanguageData.VBE_DeposedRoyalty.title: Deposed warlord
LanguageData.VBE_DeposedRoyalty.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carved out a region-spanning domain through brutal conflict, refusing to surrender [PAWN_possessive] people's right to live without oppression. Eventually, rival factions joined forces to break [PAWN_possessive] rule, and [PAWN_possessive] bodyguards forced [PAWN_objective] to flee. Failing to protect those people remains [PAWN_possessive] greatest shame.
LanguageData.VBE_Bioweapon.title: Failed FEV weapons subject
LanguageData.VBE_Bioweapon.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was exposed to a modified FEV strain in an attempt to produce an obedient supersoldier. The unstable result was marked for disposal, but the technicians failed to finish the job. [PAWN_pronoun] survived, escaped and later returned to destroy the laboratory that made [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.VBE_NatureLover.title: Animal-rescue child
LanguageData.VBE_NatureLover.baseDesc: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] kept bringing injured animals home despite every warning about bites, parasites and food shortages. [PAWN_pronoun] nursed each creature with more care than [PAWN_pronoun] gave [PAWN_objective]self. Defiance became expertise, and the settlement eventually brought its wounded animals to [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.VBE_Rocker.title: Underground protest rocker
LanguageData.VBE_Rocker.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] answered government propaganda and corporate control with loud, illegal music. Basement performances became meeting places for dissidents, smugglers and sometimes armed cells planning attacks. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to command a crowd, handle a weapon and turn anger into a chorus.
LanguageData.VBE_Sommelier.title: Strip sommelier
LanguageData.VBE_Sommelier.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] selected wines for casino dining rooms and cultivated a small vineyard beyond the Strip's walls. Pairing scarce bottles with unpredictable wasteland ingredients required an exact palate and considerable creativity. [PAWN_pronoun] treated every meal as a performance.
LanguageData.VBE_DesertSurvivor.title: Mojave exile
LanguageData.VBE_DesertSurvivor.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s enemies abandoned [PAWN_objective] in the Mojave with no water and no map. [PAWN_pronoun] survived by reading stone, wind and the movement of desert animals. Months among salt and scrub made [PAWN_objective] exceptionally hardy, but taught almost nothing about useful crops.
LanguageData.VBE_LiteraryCritic.title: Pre-War literary critic
LanguageData.VBE_LiteraryCritic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] received an elite pre-War education in literature and built a career dismantling celebrated books in print. [PAWN_possessive] reviews were learned, elegant and needlessly cruel. Authors feared [PAWN_objective], readers repeated [PAWN_possessive] verdicts, and publishers paid for the attention.
LanguageData.VBE_RodentRancher.title: Molerat rancher
LanguageData.VBE_RodentRancher.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] raised molerats beneath an overcrowded settlement where fresh meat commanded excellent caps. Customers tried not to ask what filled the stew, and inspectors tried too hard. When unpaid tithes brought armed collectors to the pens, [PAWN_pronoun] fled with [PAWN_possessive] best breeding notes.
LanguageData.VBE_PathologicalLiar.title: Wasteland tale-spinner
LanguageData.VBE_PathologicalLiar.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] can turn an empty bottle and a radroach track into an evening-long epic. Tavern crowds buy drinks while [PAWN_pronoun] piles twists upon impossible twists, changing details whenever attention wanders. Almost every tale ends with a monster, a fortune and everyone else dead.
LanguageData.VBE_Blackguard.title: Cursed drifter
LanguageData.VBE_Blackguard.baseDesc: Every town [PAWN_nameDef] entered soon suffered an accident, failed harvest or unexplained death. Superstitious residents blamed the stranger and drove [PAWN_objective] onward. Whether cursed or merely unlucky, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to build, repair and defend a life that never stayed rooted for long.
LanguageData.VBE_AndroidHunter.title: Synth hunter
LanguageData.VBE_AndroidHunter.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] earned rich bounties by identifying and pursuing synths hidden among ordinary settlers. Wealthy clients later hired [PAWN_objective] to track other dangerous prey for sport. Years of suspicion, field medicine and close violence made [PAWN_objective] formidable and abrasive.
LanguageData.VBE_LifelongPersonalAssistant.title: Programmed personal assistant
LanguageData.VBE_LifelongPersonalAssistant.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained and conditioned from childhood to serve a demanding executive household without question. [PAWN_pronoun] managed guests, gardens, meals and minor illnesses while forbidden to raise a hand against anyone. After quietly engineering [PAWN_possessive] employer's downfall, [PAWN_pronoun] escaped before the conditioning could be reinforced.
LanguageData.VBE_FormerChiefFinancialOfficer.title: Poseidon financial officer
LanguageData.VBE_FormerChiefFinancialOfficer.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] drove record profits as a senior financial officer for Poseidon Energy. When endless growth finally proved impossible, the board blamed [PAWN_objective] for disappointing shareholders. Executives familiar with company secrets rarely retired safely, so [PAWN_pronoun] vanished before security arrived.
LanguageData.VBE_ShipsNavigator.title: Convoy navigator
LanguageData.VBE_ShipsNavigator.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] charted routes for long-haul convoys moving through the wastes and across dangerous old-world corridors. [PAWN_pronoun] had an uncanny ability to find the safest and quickest paths, though [PAWN_pronoun] struggled with mechanical tasks and often left those to others.
LanguageData.VBE_EngineRoomTech.title: Reactor-room technician
LanguageData.VBE_EngineRoomTech.baseDesc: As a reactor-room technician, [PAWN_nameDef] kept long-haul rigs and settlement generators running. [PAWN_pronoun] could fix almost anything with the right tools, but lacked finesse in social interactions and avoided tasks that required a gentle touch.
LanguageData.VBE_CargoHandler.title: Convoy freight handler
LanguageData.VBE_CargoHandler.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] managed freight yards and convoy manifests, making sure supplies were securely stowed and accurately counted. [PAWN_pronoun] was strong and highly organized, but had little patience for detailed documentation or scholarly pursuits.
LanguageData.VBE_ColonyAuditor.title: Vault-Tec compliance auditor
LanguageData.VBE_ColonyAuditor.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] inspected vault inventories, ration projections and departmental spending for Vault-Tec. [PAWN_pronoun] could find a missing can or falsified requisition in pages of figures. Hands-on work and personal care, however, fell outside [PAWN_possessive] carefully defined responsibilities.
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateFinancier.title: Pre-War corporate financier
LanguageData.VBE_CorporateFinancier.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] managed investments, acquisitions and political donations for a major pre-War conglomerate. [PAWN_possessive] instinct for numbers enriched executives and ruined competitors. It did little to prepare [PAWN_objective] for physical labor or honest personal relationships.
LanguageData.VBE_YoungAstronomer.title: Observatory child
LanguageData.VBE_YoungAstronomer.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside an old observatory and spent every clear night restoring star charts from damaged terminals. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the sky, the seasons and the mathematics behind both. That obsession left little time for practical chores or friends.
